title: Stinner Frameworks Columbus Life Select Frames and Stoic Components Wheels
content:
New tubing spec and a new in-house wheel company. Today Stinner Frameworks announces Columbus Life Select frames and Stoic Components Wheels…

Stinner Frameworks announces a massive refresh for the fall/winter riding season. Stinner Select models receive a complete overhaul: Columbus Life tubing (Formerly Zona), upgraded base models to Rival AXS, and the official introduction of Stoic Components, launching 3 carbon wheelsets available as a standalone purchase and an option for all Stinner models.

Stoic is Stinner’s house-brand component line, available for the first time to riders and prototyped for years by Stinner staff and ambassadors. Launching first with a complete line of carbon wheels. Stoic Components began nearly a decade ago as a partnership with Jones Wheels, honoring the late John Jones memory.

Stinner Select 2.0 Quick Hits

  • Columbus Life Tubing Upgrade for all drop bar Select models
  • All Drop Bar Select Models receive AXS Rival Upgrade
  • New Force XPLR or Force/XO Mullet Drivetrain options
  • Stoic Carbon Wheel Upgrade
  • New build options from Vision and Terravail
  • Frameset: $2,599 / Complete starting at $5,499

Stoic Components Pricing

  • Stoic R40 // All-Road – MSRP: Starting at $1,499
  • Stoic G29 // Gravel – MSRP: Starting at $1,499
  • Stoic M34 // Mountain and Adventure – MSRP: Starting at $1,499

See wheel specs and more at Stinner Frameworks.
